newsitem.title: POLAND: DROSED NEW SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: DROSED NEW SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 360,198 shares in last month's issue of 300,000 new shares by Polish poultry producer Drosed Siedleckie Zaklady Drobiarskie SA (Drosed), the company said in a statement on Tuesday.

It said small investors registered for 20,198 shares, with the remaining 29,802 shares that had been offered to them in their 50,000-share tranche transferred to the large-investor tranche of up to 250,000 shares.
Drosed said large investors would receive about 17.7 percent fewer shares than for which they had subscribed in the issue priced at 50 zlotys per share.
Drosed expects to make a net profit of 5.8 million zlotys this year on sales of 140 million. It netted 6.1 million zlotys last year.
The company has said this year's profit would be lower because of the modernisation of a plant in Torun, northern Poland, and that its 1997 net would reach 8.6 million zlotys.
Drosed currently has 1.54 million shares outstanding.
